title: Potato, Tomato and Onion Gratin
subtitle: with a tahini glaze
description: Layers of potato, tomato and red onion baked until tender, then topped with tahini and baked until golden. Finish with fresh herbs.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Peel and thinly slice the potatoes, slice the tomatoes into 1 cm rounds and cut the onions into 1 cm rings.

Grease an ovenproof dish with olive oil. Layer the potato slices, season with salt, pepper and a little cumin if you like, then add a layer of tomato and a layer of onion rings. Drizzle with olive oil, scatter over chopped chilli and cover with foil.
Bake for about 30 minutes until the potatoes are tender. Remove the foil, spread the tahini over the top and bake for about 10 more minutes until golden.
Scatter over chopped herbs and serve hot.
